title: create thorchain-utils/solana/ module (getThorTxData, getUnsignedSolanaTransaction, getSolanaTransactionFees)
description:
Create packages/swapper/src/thorchain-utils/solana/ with 4 files. Pattern follows tron/ module.

### getThorTxData.ts
Copy from tron/getThorTxData.ts — minimal changes (same logic, different chain):
- Import getInboundAddressDataForChain from ../utils
- Import getDaemonUrl from ../utils
- Returns { vault: string } from inbound address for the sell asset

### getUnsignedSolanaTransaction.ts
Args: GetUnsignedSolanaTransactionArgs (from swapper types), swapperName: SwapperName → Promise<SolanaSignTx>

1. getThorTxData → vault
2. assertGetSolanaChainAdapter(sellAsset.chainId) → adapter
3. Build web3.js TransactionInstruction for fee estimation:
   new TransactionInstruction({ keys: [], programId: new PublicKey('MemoSq4gqABAXKb96qnH8TysNcWxMyWCqXgDLGmfcHr'), data: Buffer.from(memo, 'utf8') })
4. adapter.getFeeData({ to: vault, value: '0', chainSpecific: { from: sendAddress, instructions: [memoWebInstruction] } }) → fast
5. Build hdwallet SolanaTxInstruction: { keys: [], programId: 'MemoSq4gqABAXKb96qnH8TysNcWxMyWCqXgDLGmfcHr', data: Buffer.from(memo, 'utf8') }
6. adapter.buildSendApiTransaction({ from, to: vault, value: sellAmountIncludingProtocolFeesCryptoBaseUnit, accountNumber, chainSpecific: { instructions: [memoHdwalletInstruction], computeUnitLimit: fast.chainSpecific.computeUnits, computeUnitPrice: fast.chainSpecific.priorityFee } })

For SPL tokens: pass chainSpecific.tokenId = contractAddressOrUndefined(sellAsset.assetId) — adapter handles ATA creation.

### getSolanaTransactionFees.ts
Same fee estimation as above, only returns { networkFeeCryptoBaseUnit: fast.txFee }.

### index.ts
Export getThorTxData, getUnsignedSolanaTransaction, getSolanaTransactionFees.

Acceptance: yarn type-check passes
close_reason: Created solana/ module: getThorTxData, getUnsignedSolanaTransaction, getSolanaTransactionFees, index.ts. Type-check passes (no real TS errors, only TS6305 stale dist artifacts from parallel work).

comments.author: gomes
comments.text:
Investigation complete.

Key findings:
1. useSendThorTx (src/lib/utils/thorchain/hooks/useSendThorTx.tsx) is the central hook for all THORChain LP txs. It uses getThorchainTransactionType to decide which tx path to take.

2. getThorchainTransactionType (src/lib/utils/thorchain/index.ts:311) currently throws for Solana. Needs: add '|| chainId === solanaChainId' to the 'Send' return condition.

3. The 'Send' case in useSendThorTx uses handleSend + estimateFees from src/components/Modals/Send/utils.ts. Both already have CHAIN_NAMESPACE.Solana cases but they don't handle memo as an SPL instruction. Needs updating.

4. estimateFees Solana case (~line 110): when memo is provided, build a TransactionInstruction (web3.js) and pass it in chainSpecific.instructions for getFeeData — ensures compute budget includes memo.

5. handleSend Solana case (~line 331): when memo is provided, build a SolanaTxInstruction (hdwallet format: {keys:[], programId: MEMO_PROGRAM_ID, data: Buffer.from(memo,'utf8')}) and include in chainSpecific.instructions for buildSendTransaction.

ONLY 2 FILES needed:
- src/lib/utils/thorchain/index.ts (1-line change in getThorchainTransactionType)
- src/components/Modals/Send/utils.ts (add memo instruction handling in both estimateFees + handleSend Solana cases)

No UI changes needed — Solana already shows in the pool list, walletSupportsChain already works for Solana. No chain gating to change. parseTx already done in swapper PR.

title: wire Solana into THORChain LP add/remove liquidity
description:
Add Solana support to THORChain LP. Based on investigation (9lf.1), only 2 files need changes.

### File 1: src/lib/utils/thorchain/index.ts

In getThorchainTransactionType (~line 311), extend the 'Send' return condition:
BEFORE:
  if (isUtxoChainId(chainId) || chainId === cosmosChainId || chainId === tronChainId) {
AFTER:
  if (isUtxoChainId(chainId) || chainId === cosmosChainId || chainId === tronChainId || chainId === solanaChainId) {

Import solanaChainId from @shapeshiftoss/caip (check existing imports first).

### File 2: src/components/Modals/Send/utils.ts

MEMO_PROGRAM_ID constant near top: 'MemoSq4gqABAXKb96qnH8TysNcWxMyWCqXgDLGmfcHr'

#### In estimateFees Solana case (~line 110):
When memo is provided, build a web3.js TransactionInstruction for getFeeData to estimate compute budget including memo:
```typescript
const MEMO_PROGRAM_ID = 'MemoSq4gqABAXKb96qnH8TysNcWxMyWCqXgDLGmfcHr'

// In the Solana case of estimateFees:
const memoInstruction: TransactionInstruction | undefined = memo
  ? new TransactionInstruction({
      keys: [],
      programId: new PublicKey(MEMO_PROGRAM_ID),
      data: Buffer.from(memo, 'utf8'),
    })
  : undefined

// Pass memo instruction alongside existing instructions logic
const instructions = contractAddress
  ? await adapter.buildEstimationInstructions({ from: account, to, tokenId: contractAddress, value })
  : memoInstruction ? [memoInstruction] : undefined

// chainSpecific:
chainSpecific: { from: account, tokenId: contractAddress, instructions }
```

#### In handleSend Solana case (~line 331):
When memo is provided, build a SolanaTxInstruction (hdwallet format) and pass in chainSpecific.instructions:
```typescript
const memoInstruction: SolanaTxInstruction | undefined = memo
  ? { keys: [], programId: MEMO_PROGRAM_ID, data: Buffer.from(memo, 'utf8') }
  : undefined

// In BuildSendTxInput chainSpecific:
chainSpecific: {
  tokenId: contractAddress,
  computeUnitLimit: instructions.length > 0 ? fees.chainSpecific.computeUnits : undefined,
  computeUnitPrice: instructions.length > 0 ? fees.chainSpecific.priorityFee : undefined,
  instructions: memoInstruction ? [memoInstruction] : undefined,
}
```

SolanaTxInstruction is from @shapeshiftoss/chain-adapters solana types. Import it.

Acceptance:
- getThorchainTransactionType(solanaChainId) returns 'Send' without throwing
- estimateFees for Solana with memo includes TransactionInstruction in getFeeData call
- handleSend for Solana with memo includes SolanaTxInstruction in buildSendTransaction
- yarn type-check passes, yarn lint --fix passes
close_reason: Added solanaChainId to getThorchainTransactionType 'Send' case. Added SPL Memo Program instruction handling in estimateFees (web3.js TransactionInstruction) and handleSend (SolanaTxInstruction) Solana cases in Send/utils.ts. Only 2 files changed.
